messages:
devon (CSM): Heads up — three accounts (Kore, Lumis, Arbor) clicked opt-out on the preview invite in the last 24h. Need to re-engage and capture why. Enrollment sheet (private): https://go.redwood/preview-enroll

maya (CS): Thanks. Any of them on renewal clocks? Also we should tag as 'beta_optout' in CRM so AEs see potential risk.

ryan (SE): Kore renewal ~70 days, Arbor ~120 days, Lumis not immediate. Kore already flagged security questions on the last call — likely the main blocker.

alex (PM): Can we try a micro-survey first (2 quick Qs) before booking 30m calls? Q1: main reason for opting out (security / integration / not using / other). Q2: Would a 30m enablement help? (yes/no).

devon (CSM): I'll send that. Draft email below — please tweak before I send to the three accounts.

devon (CSM): ```Subject: Quick feedback on Redwood Preview

Hi {{first_name}},

I noticed you opted out of the Redwood preview program. We'd really appreciate 60 seconds of feedback to help us improve.

1) Primary reason for opting out: [security / integration effort / not using right now / other — brief]
2) Would a short 30-minute enablement session make you more likely to participate? [Yes / No]

If you'd prefer a quick sync, pick a time: https://cal.redwood/sync

Thanks — Devon (CSM)```

calendar-bot: Tentative event created for Kore — Fri 10:00 PT. Invite sent, will auto-cancel if no RSVP.

maya (CS): Please add renewal owner tag and set account_risk: medium for Kore + Arbor. I'll log the 'beta_optout' flag in Gainsight and notify AEs.

priya (CS Lead): Also capture verbatim feedback in the preview feedback doc: https://go.redwood/preview-feedback. If security comes up, route to eng-security + docs for a short FAQ call.

ryan (SE): Copying the private-deploy FAQ and dedicated onboarding checklist to Kore's DM now. If they want an architecture walkthrough we'll set a separate tech session.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — follow-up in 7 days if no response.

devon (CSM): Action items (who/when):
- Devon: send micro-survey to Kore, Lumis, Arbor (today)
- Ryan: share security/private-deploy docs with Kore (today)
- Maya: update CRM tags + set account_risk where needed (today)
- Alex: add experiment note + hold rollout for flagged accounts if we see repeated security/integration responses
- Ops-bot: create 7-day follow-up reminders

alex (PM): +1. If >1 opt-out cites security or model quality, we'll pause canary for that cohort and run a short eval using their prompt set.

devon (CSM): Will post send receipts and any replies here. Thanks team :mega:
